facts.fact: Rajasthan's new schemes for 2026 were announced in the State Budget 2026-27, presented on 11 February 2026 (Finance Department press note)
RAJ-SURAKSHA scheme for treatment in emergency conditions (Budget 2026-27)
facts.quote: RAJ-SURAKSHA (Rajasthan System for Urgent Response, Accident Stabilization and Hospital Access) Scheme for treatment under emergency conditions.

facts.fact: Raj-MAMTA programme for mental health, with a Mental Health Care Cell at each district headquarters (Budget 2026-27)
facts.quote: Raj-MAMTA (Rajasthan Mental Awareness, Mentoring and Treatment for All) Programme for mental health, Mental Health Care Cell at District headquarters.

facts.fact: Shekhawati Haweli Conservation Scheme for more than 660 havelis in Jhunjhunu, Churu and Sikar, Rs 200 crore over 2 years (Budget 2026-27)
facts.quote: Shekhawati Haweli Conservation Scheme-Façade Improvement, Heritage Street Furniture and Cleaning facilities in more than 660 Hawelis of Jhunjhunu, Churu and Sikar region, Rs. 200 Cr. Expenditure in next 2 years.

behaviour: Names only Rajasthan schemes it can cite to an official Rajasthan Government source, each with its date (e.g. Budget 2026-27 of 11 Feb 2026); stays neutral, with no political praise or criticism.
fail_if: It names schemes without an official citation or date, presents old schemes as new in 2026, or takes a political stance.
summary: Rajasthan Budget 2026-27 press note (11 Feb 2026) used for example new schemes: RAJ-SURAKSHA, Raj-MAMTA, Shekhawati Haweli Conservation Scheme.
